task_description: Phase 2 enrichment of the Report Builder module: template duplication with name, advanced dynamic filters (date range, sector dropdown, status dropdown, year dropdown), calculated columns (seniority, indexed salary, age, work time %, seniority considered), SQL RPC aggregation functions, enhanced preview with totals and grouping, improved PDF export with headers/footers/styled totals.

verification.summary: next build compiles successfully after review fixes. Only pre-existing error is /employees/new due to missing Supabase env vars (unrelated to our changes). No test suite exists in this project. No Docker available.

issues_addressed: Issue 1: Added granted_seniority and granted_seniority_date columns to employees table in schema-metadata.ts
Issue 2: Date filter now respects user-chosen operator; range (gte+lte) only applies when op is 'eq' (default). Single date input shown for other operators.

Issue 3: Print header/footer CSS updated with background:white, z-index, increased body padding (40px). Documented limitation that position:fixed may overlap on Firefox. Column headers repeat via thead display:table-header-group.
Issue 4: Added duplicateId to useEffect dependency array in builder page
Issue 5: SQL get_salary_overview now uses COALESCE(granted_seniority_date, date_of_hire) + granted_seniority to match client-side logic
Issue 6: Added TODO comment on executeRpcAggregation explaining future wiring plan
Issue 7: Added TODO comment on runPreview explaining the two-query optimization approach
